channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-postgres
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: psql_bm25s — via awesome-postgres
item.description: PostgreSQL extension for BM25-family lexical retrieval with a native index access method and SQL top-k query APIs.

item.title: pgxcli — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Postgres CLI with autocompletion and syntax highlighting written in Go.

item.title: pgwd — via awesome-postgres
item.description: monitors PostgreSQL connection usage and stale sessions, with threshold alerts, Prometheus metrics, and multiple notification backends.

item.title: pgvitals — via awesome-postgres
item.description: collection of 40 read-only diagnostic queries for spotting common performance problems (slow queries, bloat, vacuum lag, lock contention, replication lag, wraparound risk) using only the standard system catalog with no extensions required, plus an optional CLI that aggregates them into a 0-100 health score.

item.title: pgrls — via awesome-postgres
item.description: static analyzer for row-level security policies; 36 rules across security, performance, and hygiene with 10 mechanically auto-fixable; includes a semantic policy-diff command for CI gating.

item.title: pglayers — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Pre-built PostgreSQL extensions as composable Docker layers. 50+ extensions, ready-to-use combined images (full, Azure-compatible).

item.title: pgfence — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Lints Postgres SQL migrations for lock modes and risky DDL, with safe expand/contract rewrites. CLI plus LSP. Extractors for Prisma, TypeORM, and Knex.

item.title: pgFirstAid — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Easy-to-deploy, open source PostgreSQL function that provides a prioritized list of actions to improve database stability and performance. Directly inspired by Brent Ozar's FirstResponderKit for SQL Server.

item.title: neond — via awesome-postgres
item.description: DX-focused control plane for Postgres with branching, PITR, and S3 durability. Ships as a single Docker container with a web dashboard; positions itself as a postgres:latest replacement for non-critical workloads.

item.title: TablePro — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Native macOS PostgreSQL client with explain visualization, ER diagrams, and AI assistant. Free, open-source.

item.title: Rivestack — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Managed PostgreSQL with pgvector pre-installed and HNSW-tuned for vector search. Free tier (2 GB, no credit card), flat-priced dedicated instances from $15/month, EU and US regions.

item.title: PostgreSQL Access Control — via awesome-postgres
item.description: The complete mental model: roles, grants, ownership, membership, policies, and default privileges as an integrated system. PDF + video, ~60 min.

item.title: PgStudio — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Open-source VS Code / Open VSX extension for PostgreSQL management with SQL notebooks, AI assistant, Easy to use code snippets and Full-fledged DBMS with real-time monitoring dashboard.

item.title: OrcaQ — via awesome-postgres
item.description: A modern, open-source database editor for PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and more. Features an AI assistant, ERD visualizer, schema diff, and visual role management.

item.title: Dekart — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Open-source platform to turn PostGIS queries into shareable interactive maps.

item.title: AI for Database — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Chat with your PostgreSQL database in natural language. No SQL needed — get instant insights, build self-refreshing dashboards, and trigger automated workflows based on database changes. (Commercial Software).

item.title: 1bench — via awesome-postgres
item.description: Native cross-platform GUI with first-class Postgres support alongside Redis, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Qdrant, and more (Commercial Software).
